# core

a rule this linked role always carries, at full weight — it sits at `say`, so every
session that boots this role pays for every line of it.

the point of this fixture is that the payload is comfortably past a 20-token cap, so
the consumer's gate has a real overage to report rather than an artifact of a rounded
count — and then declines to halt on it anyway, because the spec is not the consumer's.
